ESA 2026 competitor bridge. Upstream rembed a81b216a2a63bde3d4447e4053b4ca31081fe286
SNN ea7a2db86ce1c5353998fa8f7f68e6f4d8dc6945
Adaptations: selected Rust wrappers converted f32 to f64; normalized uint32 coordinates exactly by 2^-32. Circle enclosure with outward numerical margin, followed by exact integer membership filtering. Nabo self matches enabled. Neighbourhood representative indices repaired for duplicates. Grid out-of-bounds query guard and raw Vec spare-capacity write repaired. Static 2D and dimensional Grid width uses the arithmetic mean query radius, available as declared workload metadata before construction; .001 is retained as fallback for empty/zero-radius workloads. This is not timing-based tuning. All timing includes bridge and filtering. Parallel features disabled; pin runs to one CPU. Python SNN uses original implementation with float64 inputs.
SPRK vendored revision 4c08d8590ff901bb599a283481053e3232860adb (0.2.0); not a claim to reproduce the paper's binaries. Main comparison covers Table 2, not ablation variants. SNN is py_snn, as confirmed by upstream plotting scripts.
Kiddo 5.0.3 is vendored with one bug fix in src/float_leaf_slice/leaf_slice.rs: nearest_n_within remainder result item uses remainder_items[idx] instead of self.content_items[idx]. Otherwise leaf tails report IDs from the start of the leaf. Discovered by exact point-multiset regression tests.
Build uses Rust 1.99.0 release optimization and -Ctarget-cpu=native. Python package versions recorded in python-requirements.txt.
Current SPRK adapters: esa_sprk_MANUALLY_ADAPTED_INTEGER_POINTS (2D),
esa_sprk (dimensional), and esa_sprk_CHEATING_IDS_ONLY (IDs-only diagnostic).
SPRK 0.2.0 by Dennis Kobert and Tobias Kempf remains MIT licensed.
The current adapters use the upstream f32 tree and native SIMD candidate writer.
Original uint32 points remain available for gathering and exact membership.
Radius expansion accounts for floating arithmetic and coordinate quantization;
higher-dimensional cancellation-based kernels receive an additional allowance.
Construction includes coordinate conversion and retained storage. Query timing
includes candidate search, exact integer filtering and final output writes.
Coordinate reporting writes explicit points; IDs-only reporting writes individual
accepted IDs. Both apply the same membership contract. The bridge exposes its
completed reusable vector without a second coordinate copy in C++.

Dynamic reporting adapter revision (2026-10-07): direct radius requests to
mutable Kiddo via its native unsorted iterator; output packed IDs decoded to
original integer points, followed by one common exact circle filter. No changes
to the upstream index implementation in this revision.

Static reporting adapter revision (2026-10-07): Neighbourhood coordinates are
converted directly back to uint32 without a coordinate-to-ID hash lookup.
Python query arrays are reused and returned NumPy IDs are read through the
buffer protocol, avoiding tolist and repeated query-array allocation.
VP-tree uses acap's public fixed-radius Neighborhood visitor with the original
search traversal, avoiding kNN heap maintenance and sorting. This shared
wrapper also serves the d-dimensional campaign. Immutable Kiddo retains its
native result-vector API; Nabo retains its native unsorted kNN-with-radius API.
No upstream search predicates or correctness failures are repaired here.

Audit adapter revision (2026-10-09): replaces the former f64/scalar SPRK
reporting path with the f32 candidate path described above. Runtime loading and
Python imports are outside construction timing. All dimensions receive outward
margins and exact integer post-filtering. Grid receives the mean query-radius
hint in dimensional as well as 2D campaigns. Other ESA wrappers remain f64
adaptations, as disclosed above. Historical timings do not measure this revision.
